## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:把 `engine.ts` 里「驱动选项与引擎租户姿态」整段 6 个方法和它们独用的一个辅助函数原样搬进新文件 `engine-driver-options.ts`,类上方法签名与注释不变,只把方法体换成转交。`engine.ts` 22,651 → 22,517 行。
- **为什么改**:#25522 按缝拆分 `engine.ts` 的第 12 刀;本段在刀前重测的缝表里净减行最多,且不与在途 PR 重叠。
- **风险与回滚**:纯搬移,无行为变化;公开 `.d.ts` 六个文件逐字节不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/objectql/src/engine-driver-options.ts`(搬入的方法体)、`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`(6 个转交桩)、`scripts/adr-anchors/` 两个 JSON(ADR 锚段落按方法拆分)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`,应见 472 个测试文件全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

Cut 12 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6429419365`. The whole "Driver options and engine posture" section moves unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-driver-options.ts`: `buildDriverOptions` (the `DriverOptions` every driver call receives), `driverReadScope` (the Layer 0 verdict projected onto a read's driver scope), `engineLayer0Verdict` (that verdict over the engine's own facts), `wallExemptedOperation` (did the wall's exemption lift an operation's scope), `driverWriteTarget` (an insert's write target) and `resolveEnginePosture` (the tenancy posture in force). The one module helper only they use, `accessibleOrganizationsOf`, moves with them. No behaviour changes. #25522 stays open for the later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-isr622` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `222755ebb`, which contains cut 11's merge (`fc70ab36ba`, #26351). Nothing was edited before that merge landed. `origin/main` (`6390fe52c`) was merged in once before this PR opened; none of the commits it brought touch `packages/objectql/**`, `packages/core/src/security/**`, `content/docs/permissions/**`, `scripts/adr-anchors/**` or `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs`.

## What changes

The script lists `engineLayer0Verdict` as blocked by its helper `accessibleOrganizationsOf`, whose other user is `driverWriteTarget`. `driverWriteTarget` alone does not pay (a 4-line body behind a 5-line stub, +1), but moving it with `engineLayer0Verdict` lets the helper go too, so the pair pays about -19 together with it. That is the order's reading ("`engineLayer0Verdict` only together with `driverWriteTarget`"), and it empties the section.

### The shape

- The class keeps all six methods with name, modifiers (`private`), signature, docblock and position. Each body is now one host literal of exactly the `DriverOptionsHost` members it reads, plus a `.call`, marked `[#25522 cut 12]`, as cuts 8, 10 and 11 did. Fields go as getters over a `readX` closure (`txStore`, `_registry`, `tenancyPostureProvider`); methods go as late-bound closures (`isClosedUnitHandle`, `transactionCoversDriverFor`, `driverWriteTarget`, `driverReadScope`, `wallExemptedOperation`, `engineLayer0Verdict`, `resolveEnginePosture`), so a spy or double set on the engine is still the one a call reaches.
- **One named host.** `DriverOptionsHost` types each member as the class member (`ObjectQL['txStore']` and so on); each function's `this` is the `Pick` of what it reads. The module imports the engine only as a type.
- **The helper.** `accessibleOrganizationsOf` moves with its docblock byte for byte and is not exported; both its users moved. One copy, no re-derivation.
- **Imports.** The module imports `isTenancyDisabled` (`@objectstack/spec/data`), `ExecutionContext` (type), `computeTenantLayer0Verdict` (`@objectstack/core`, with its two-line import comment), `resolveTenantFieldName` (`./tenancy/system-write-organization.js`), `resolveTenancyPosture` (`@objectstack/types`), `normalizeTenancyPosture`, `TenantLayer0VerdictSchema` and the types `TenancyPosture` / `TenantLayer0Verdict` (`@objectstack/spec/security`) and `isFederatedObject` (`./federated-object.js`). `engine.ts` drops `isTenancyDisabled`, `computeTenantLayer0Verdict` (with its comment), `resolveTenancyPosture` (the whole import line), `normalizeTenancyPosture` and `TenantLayer0VerdictSchema`, whose last code readers moved (three of them are still named in docblocks that stay, which no linter counts as a use), and gains the module import with a three-line comment. `isFederatedObject`, `resolveTenantFieldName` and the two types keep readers in `engine.ts` and stay imported there.
- The module header names what moved and why nothing stays, and names ADR-0119 and ADR-0067 (the anchor ids, below) without a decision letter.

### Net lines (the seat's rule)

`engine.ts` goes from 22,651 to 22,517 lines, **net -134** (44 added, 178 removed). The module is 304 lines. With the path readers below, the diff against `origin/main` is 544 changed lines over 7 files (+361 / -183).

### Readers of the moved lines (migrated in this PR)

  - **New entry** `packages__objectql__src__engine-driver-options.ts.json`, `adrs: ["ADR-0067", "ADR-0119"]` (ADR-0119's same-origin amendment, recorded on the 2026-08-06 ruling with ADR-0067's): the opening sentence ("The transaction seam is same-origin by construction (#5351/#5696, 2026-08-06 ruling).") plus the `buildDriverOptions` sentence verbatim, plus the last clause of the paragraph's closing sentence, "Never restore the unconditional handle lift."
  - **The `engine.ts` entry keeps** its three ids, the same opening sentence, the `enforceTransactionOrigin` sentences verbatim, and the closing sentence's first clause, "Never add a companion transaction on the second driver (no two-phase commit in IDataDriver)."
  - So the only words that change are the split of the closing sentence at its "and" (the second clause now starts a sentence) and the opening sentence, which both halves carry. `engine-execute-transactions.ts`'s entry (cut 7) still carries the whole paragraph; this PR does not edit it.
  - **Decision-letter count:** `check-adr-anchors` at base `222755ebb` (clean detached worktree): 90 anchored files, **1,877** decision-letter citations, 59,281 resolving citations. At head `1b8e2b8b1`: 91, **1,877**, 59,285; at the merged head `17781355c`: 91, **1,877**, 59,316 (main's own citations). The letter-citing body comments that moved (`ADR-0131 D8`, `D9`, `D13`, the `ADR-0131 D8` import comment and the helper's `ADR-0105 D2`) left `engine.ts` but now count in the newly anchored module, so the count is equal.
- **The system-context census page.** `buildDriverOptions` reads `execCtx?.isSystem` (row 24, "Tenant-audit warning silenced"). The row's anchor in `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` and its `NON_READ_ANCHORS` entry in `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs` (`collapsesOntoRead`, file key only) now name `engine-driver-options.ts#buildDriverOptions`. **Control:** with the move and neither re-key, the census fails with `[ledger-stale-collapse]` and `[anchor-is-not-a-read-site]` on `engine.ts#buildDriverOptions`; with both re-keys (and the module tracked), it passes: 153 read sites across 83 files (82 at base), 145 of 145 symbols cited.
- **The federated injected-column readers table.** `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` keys rows `FILE#FUNCTION :: SEAM`; the two `buildDriverOptions` rows (`isFederatedObject()`, `resolveTenantFieldName()`) are re-keyed to `engine-driver-options.ts#buildDriverOptions`, dispositions unchanged.
- No `objectql/src/engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `docs/qa/**` or `content/**` names a moved member other than row 24. Prose that names `buildDriverOptions` or `resolveEnginePosture` (ADRs 0034, 0119 and 0131, driver and plugin comments, tests, CHANGELOGs) still resolves, because the methods stay on the class. No core census keys a moved body (`row-serving-door-exposure` keys `.canReadObject(` callers and `second-object-read-exposure` keys `referenceTargetOf(` callers; the moved bodies make neither call). No moved body holds a `query-options/no-any-erasure` site (`engine.ts` stays at 8 in `query-options-erasure-baseline.json`) or a tenant-audit untyped receiver.

## Acceptance notes

- **Serial check**, re-read before `pr_create` (17 open PRs at 00:38Z): two touch `packages/objectql/**`. #26337 (ADR-0142 phase 2, head `9ada3a920`) edits `engine.ts` in nine hunks (an import near line 245, three declarations near lines 3916, 4221 and 4751, and the `insert` / `update` bodies from base line 15629 on) and adds rows to `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` near line 355. None is in the moved section (base lines 7141 to 7471), on the import lines or helper this cut edits, or on the two re-keyed rows (line 188). `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head with its head merges cleanly (exit 0). Under the card's rule 4 whichever lands second merges `main`. #26138 edits `validation/rule-validator.test.ts` only. No open PR touches `system-context.mdx`, `check-system-context-census.mjs` or `scripts/adr-anchors/`.
- **Receiver note, not a change in what runs:** `resolveEnginePosture` calls `this.tenancyPostureProvider?.()`. In the class the call's receiver was the engine; in the module it is the host, whose getter returns the same function. The one production registration (`plugin-security`'s `setTenancyPostureProvider(() => this.tenancyPosture)`) and every test registration pass arrow functions, so nothing reads the receiver. `this.txStore.getStore()` and `this._registry.getObject(...)` keep their own receivers (the store and the registry).
- **A stale sentence elsewhere, not edited:** `engine-realtime-publish.ts`'s header says `accessibleOrganizationsOf` stays in `engine.ts`; after this cut it lives in `engine-driver-options.ts`. The file is outside this claim's surface, so it is left for the seat to route.
- **Next cut from this screen:** Migration flags and attestations (about -91) still needs a setter ruling; Readable-ids (about -87) is blocked by three shared module helpers; the rest pay -30 or less. A ruling on Migration flags' setters is the next lever.
